description: Which body measurements a CONFIRMED design needs. Read by the backend (app/logic/measurement_schema.py: validation, saving, engine input) and by the frontend (src/utils/measurementSchema.js: which fields are shown and required). A field is required when every condition in a rule's `when` matches the confirmed design (an empty `when` always matches). Derived from what the drafting engine actually uses (backend/app/logic/drafting/): hip only shapes the side seam below the waist, height is used by no drafting equation, wrist only where the sleeve tapers to the wrist.

rules.why: bodice block: width, neck, shoulder, armhole and hem level
the hem is at or below the waist, so the side seam is shaped to the hip
a sleeve is drafted: its width at the bicep and the wanted sleeve length
a long plain or puff sleeve tapers to the wrist (a bell sleeve flares instead)
